notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Dear Hero,

Test your strength and last as long as possible in infinite mode. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332829/2048dd96af5f297bcbbc5847a7843f2f4d1d9bd3.jpg

Added a new level (infinite mode). The new mode will be available after completing the first location (Forest of Forbidden Fruits). 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332829/52844fe014cdf93634b25de732cf2e993578cc00.png

You can always challenge yourself in this mode and see how long you can last while defending the temple from hordes of enemies.

You can spend all your accumulated love potions in infinite mode to unlock 6 animated lewd 2D images of priestesses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332829/d3e63d429fe4f1f4dc88bd4951de94d68b23507b.gif

In addition, animated priestesses have been added to the gallery. In the gallery there is a button shown on the screenshot, clicking on which will take you to the gallery of animated 2D images of love priestesses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332829/fbf7c536ed783e8f97bf5084b5d16024ddbf617e.png

Also, new VFX effects have been added and minor bugs have been fixed.

Thank you.

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
Japanese language added to the game. 

A bomb has been added to the game. With a certain probability the bomb can be dropped from the enemies. To use the bomb, just click on it, and in a second an explosion will occur, which will cause a lot of damage to the enemies around the bomb. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332829/29ebcfe18fb4865890515a9430a98e3007ee2e59.gif

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
A time acceleration feature has been added to the game. In the bottom left corner of your interface you will see time switches x1 and x2.
x1 - normal speed.
x2 - double time acceleration.

A new minion of Avaritia, the Necromancer, has been added.
He has the ability to summon skeletons.
Necromancer appears from the second location.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332829/852f3c555579a3c398fa6f6900d2fc386d8b308d.gif

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
A new Avaritia minion has been added to the game - Warlock. He will be found in all locations. A ranged fighter who attacks your temple and the spirits of love from a great distance with deadly black magic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332829/0278a60a5d4b3a18697d24e486c894255666ff4e.gif

Drop chests have been added to the game. If fortune smiles on you, a chest with gold or love potions can drop from the enemy. When you open the chest you will get a random amount of resources, which will depend on your luck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44332829/d092ecf833b0d6a9ad88ac712c51cb948a16f3a8.gif

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Rebalanced some enemies.
Added a new minion of Avaritia, the Shaman, to all locations.
The Shaman heals all minions around him. 
This enemy can significantly affect the course of the battle, so try to destroy him as soon as possible.
